title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. In this part of the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets', Grothendieck studies automorphisms of the profinite completion of SL(2,Z) (or of π_{0,3}^, the profinite free group on two generators) that normalise the inertia subgroup L_0. L_0 is generated by l_0 = ε_0². He has parametrised the resulting group M_{ρ,σ}[0] by triples (u, a, b) lying in a Z-group scheme G*_{ρ,σ} = B'_0 × T_ρ × N'_σ. Here:
- B'_0 is the Borel-type group of matrices (μ λ; 0 1);
- T_ρ is the torus attached to Z[ρ], ρ a primitive cube/sixth root of unity;
- N'_σ is the normaliser of the torus attached to Z[i].
The invariants α, β, ε, ε', μ of an automorphism determine the triple via a = α^{-1}u and b = β^{-1}u. The aim of these pages is to compute the images of the three standard generators r_0, r_1, r_∞ of GL(2,Z) in M_{ρ,σ}[0](Z) ⊂ M_{ρ,σ}[0](Ẑ).

This page.
(i) It finishes the general NB begun on the previous page. Take u = (μ λ; 0 1) ∈ B'_0(Ẑ) acting by conjugation, and take f = 1. Then α = u, so a = 1. Since μ ∈ {±1}, write μ = (-1)^k with k ∈ Z/2. Then ε = ε' = μ, and β = u τ_∞^k, so b = τ_∞^k. This gives (37): u ↦ (u, 1, τ_∞^k) ∈ G*_{ρ,σ}(Ẑ) = (B'_0 × T_ρ × N'_σ)(Ẑ). A partly struck remark adds that this element is not in ΓG*_{ρ,σ}(0) unless λ = 0.
(ii) Case 2°: r_1 = -τ'_0 = (-1 1; 0 1). This is the case μ = -1, λ = 1, giving (38): r_1 ↦ ((-1 1; 0 1), 1, τ_∞) ∈ M_{ρ,σ}[0](Z). A marginal NB appears to say that, modulo L_0, the elements r_0/τ_0 and r_1 have the same image (1, 1, τ_∞) in G*_{ρ,σ}.
(iii) Case 3°: r_∞ = τ'_∞ = (0 1; 1 0). This automorphism is not realised by normalising L_0. Grothendieck remarks this is just as well: r_0, r_1, r_∞ generate GL(2,Z) (or 'only' its subgroup GL(2,Z)'), so they cannot all lie in the Borel part. He writes τ'_∞ = τ_∞ σ_∞ with σ_∞ = (0 -1; 1 0). Its image is therefore the product of the image of τ_∞ (computed in 1°, namely (τ_∞, 1, τ_∞)) and the image of σ_∞. The latter is tautological, since SG ≅ S^+_{ρ,σ} and σ_∞ ∈ SG(Z). The next page finishes this: it gets (-1, 1, τ_∞) and computes the finite group (T_0 × T_ρ × N'_σ)(Z) ≅ Z/2 × Z/6 × D_4.

Overall, this is a bookkeeping step in identifying the arithmetic (Z-point) part of an automorphism group of SL(2,Z)^ via the amalgam Z/4 *_{Z/2} Z/6.
errors: No substantive error found. The checks τ_∞σ_∞ = diag(-1,1)(0 -1; 1 0) = (0 1; 1 0) and consistency of (37) at λ=0, μ=-1 with the previous page's (τ_∞, 1, τ_∞) both work.
The page is internally hesitant about whether (37) lies in ΓG*_{ρ,σ}(0) (struck passage: 'sauf si λ=0'). This qualification is left only half-integrated into the text.
Grothendieck himself flags uncertainty whether r_0, r_1, r_∞ generate GL(2,Z) or only an index-2 subgroup GL(2,Z)'; this is not resolved on the page.

ideas.what: Image of a Borel element u=(μ λ;0 1) of GL(2,Ẑ) in the parametrisation (u,a,b) of automorphisms of SL(2,Z)^ normalising inertia: (u,1,τ_∞^k) with μ=(-1)^k.
ideas.modern_name: explicit description of the outer action of GL(2,Z) on the profinite completion of SL(2,Z)=Z/4*_{Z/2}Z/6, preserving the cusp inertia
ideas.usually_credited_to: general framework related to Grothendieck–Teichmüller theory (Drinfeld 1990; Ihara; Lochak–Schneps; Nakamura)
ideas.where_published: Only in these unpublished Montpellier notes; the general programme is sketched in Esquisse d'un programme.

ideas.what: Decomposition τ'_∞ = τ_∞σ_∞, computing the image of the non-Borel generator as a product of a Borel image and a tautological torus image.
ideas.modern_name: generators of GL(2,Z) as products of reflections and elliptic elements

ideas.what: The group scheme G*_{ρ,σ}=B'_0×T_ρ×N'_σ over Z as a parameter space for the 'tame' automorphisms of SL(2,Z)^, with finite Z-points Z/2×Z/6×D_4 (next page).
ideas.modern_name: algebraic group model of automorphisms of the profinite modular group fixing the elliptic (Z/4, Z/6) and cusp subgroups

deep.surprise_reason: The page is routine case-by-case computation within Grothendieck's private framework for automorphisms of SL(2,Z)^. The overall framework, a Z-group-scheme parametrisation of automorphism invariants, may be unpublished, but nothing on this specific page constitutes a new result or connection.
transcription_corrections: The page number written at the top is 504 (Grothendieck's own pagination); the archive number 405 is at bottom left.
'2°) τ_1 = -τ'_0' should read '2°) r_1 = -τ'_0' (lowercase r, the generator), both in the struck line and in the kept line; in (38) the left side is likewise 'r_1 = -τ'_0'.
The marginal note likely reads: 'NB réduisant mod L_0, τ_0 et r_1 ont même image dans G*_{ρσ}, savoir (1,1,τ_∞)'. Here 'jouir' is probably 'savoir'.
Line 3°: probably 'cette fois-ci on a un automorphisme des S^+_{αβ} ou S^{+∧}_{αβ} non normalisant/réalisé par L_0'.
Last lines: 'Une notation que r_∞ = τ'_∞ a donc pour image ...' rather than 'τ_∞=τ'_∞'.
In (37), the struck symbol before G*_{ρ,σ} is an aborted 'SG'; underneath, (B'_0×T_ρ×N'_σ)(Ẑ) is identified with M_{ρ,σ}[0](Ẑ).
